description: Route a task to the best available free AI model and run inference. DPX selects the model based on the task type (reasoning, code, multilingual, fast), calls OpenRouter, and returns the completion. All models are free-tier — no token cost. Use this when an agent needs to delegate a subtask to a language model without managing model selection or API keys.

messages.description: Optional. Full message array in OpenAI format [{role, content}]. If omitted, task is sent as a user message.

preferSpeed.description: true = use the fastest available free model regardless of task type. Default false.

task.description: Plain-language description of what the model should do. Used for model selection.

name: compute.route
